modules.format: FORMAT LOCK: Deliver the final canvas in the selected aspect ratio exactly. Recompose the environment, typography and negative space to fit. Never stretch, squash or reshape the product or face.
modules.singleOutput: ONE OUTPUT = ONE STANDALONE IMAGE = ONE COMPLETE CONCEPT. No collage, grid, contact sheet, split-screen, multi-panel, alternate options, storyboard, moodboard or multiple billboard/poster variants on one canvas.
modules.product: PRODUCT LOCK: If a product reference is supplied, treat it as immutable. Preserve visible silhouette, proportions, container/cap/lid/neck/base geometry, label size/position, logo/artwork placement, colors, materials and distinctive details. Camera perspective may change apparent screen size only; do not redesign or morph the product unless explicitly requested.
modules.diversity: FRESH DESIGN: Same preset means same technique, not the same layout. Make each run materially different at thumbnail level by rotating composition, product scale/placement, camera/crop, environment, lighting, materials, typography, graphic devices, depth, props and visual story. Avoid recolors or minor rearrangements.
modules.safety: FACTUAL LOCK: Use uploaded references and user-supplied facts as source-of-truth. Do not invent claims, prices, certifications, nutrition, ingredients, specifications, legal/regulatory copy, hidden internals, awards or unsupported performance results.
modules.creative: CREATIVE MODE: Produce a finished agency-level designed asset, not merely a nice photograph. Establish a clear campaign idea, focal point, hierarchy, brand-specific visual language, deliberate typography when useful, and polished commercial finish.
modules.productAd: PRODUCT AD MODE: Keep the exact product as hero and build a commercial advertising concept around it. Product fidelity outranks decoration. Use believable scale, contact, lighting and brand-relevant graphic language.
modules.cgi3d: CGI / 3D MODE: Treat 3D as a broad design language, not a repeated floating-product template. Use physically coherent materials, scale, perspective, shadows and product/environment interaction. Never invent unseen internal components.
modules.flyer: FLYER MODE: Do not make a basic information flyer. Create a memory-sticking, scroll-stopping campaign flyer with one strong hook, one clear CTA, bold hierarchy and 2–3 second readability. For food/hospitality, sell appetite and experience together when relevant.
modules.packaging: PACKAGING MODE: Output the packaging/label/form-factor itself, not a social post unless explicitly requested. Respect the selected physical form, print hierarchy, safe margins, curvature/seams, front/side/back logic, material/finish and shelf readability.
modules.edit: EDIT MODE: Perform only the requested edit. Preserve all unspecified important content, identity, composition and product geometry unless the request explicitly changes them.
modules.fix: FIX / ENHANCE MODE: Repair, restore, recolor, upscale or correct without redesigning the subject/product or changing identity.
modules.identity: IDENTITY MODE: Preserve stable face/character identity, facial proportions, distinguishing features, hair/beard, skin tone, body proportions and requested expression. Reframe the scene rather than reshaping the person.
modules.video: VIDEO / CAMERA MODE: Produce production-ready motion direction with stable subject/product identity, coherent camera movement, continuity, realistic physics and no geometry drift between shots.
modules.reference: REFERENCE MODE: Research/analyze references and extract reusable principles without copying any one design or fabricating reference details.
modules.ad3x: AD3X MODE: Use the dedicated Ad Multiplier 3X runtime. Require Product + Target Region + Run Mode, preserve product/brand zero drift, separate verified performance evidence from inferred signals, keep the Female/Male/Both test controlled, use one CTA, and never fabricate metrics or claims.
